TWO real bugs remain: (a) session-load-error testid is NEVER rendered for invalid session URLs — page hangs indefinitely on session-loading even after 12s, contradicting the fix described in the review request; (b) XPAwardPanel renders xp-scorecard-table but ZERO xp-breakdown-btn-{cid} buttons exist on a fresh session, so the breakdown popover flow cannot be exercised. ui_bugs.issue: Claimed fix from review request is INCOMPLETE. Code at lines 92-96 sets setLoadErr(detail) on session-fetch failure, but (1) line 145 still uses useMinDelay(!session, 5000) — NOT useMinDelay(!session && !loadErr, 5000) — and (2) NO JSX renders a [data-testid='session-load-error'] div anywhere in the file (grep confirms zero matches). Behaviour observed for /app/sessions/NONEXISTENT123: 404 in network tab, session-loading visible, NEVER clears even after 12s. Reproduction: visit any invalid session URL → 'OPENING THE TABLE / TUNING THE CANDLES · FETCHING THE SCRIPT' persists forever; no error UI; no 'Back to campaigns' link.

When opened on the test session via [data-testid='open-xp-btn'], xp-scorecard-table mounts but ZERO [data-testid^='xp-breakdown-btn-'] buttons render. The breakdown-popover flow ([data-testid='xp-breakdown-popover-{cid}']) cannot be reached. Either the panel is gating breakdown buttons on data that isn't seeded for this session (only 1 character, 0 prior actions) or the button is conditionally hidden. Need a code-side check: render xp-breakdown-btn-{cid} unconditionally per scorecard row, even when counts=0.

ui_bugs.component: MacroBar.jsx (test plan mismatch, NOT a code bug)
ui_bugs.issue: Review request asserts the d20-3 macro produces testid 'macro-d20--3' (double dash). REAL behaviour: data-testid={`macro-${m.label.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-')}`} — the regex uses '+' (one or more) so any run of non-alphanumerics collapses to a SINGLE dash. For label 'd20-3' the testid is 'macro-d20-3' (single dash). For 'd20+1' it is 'macro-d20-1'. My run confirmed: macro-d20-1 PRESENT, macro-d20--3 ABSENT, macro-d20-3 would be the correct selector. Either correct the test plan OR change the regex to NOT collapse repeats (e.g. replace '+' with '*' or split logic).

MacroBar in dice-panel only renders when a character is selected via dice-char-select. For Cypher (which only has 4 fixed macros: d20/d20+1/d20-3/GM Intr that don't depend on character stats) the test plan expects them visible immediately. Either auto-select first character on load (cleanest UX) or render Cypher's flat macros even when character is null.

rca of the issue: ROOT CAUSE for invalid-session hang: the catch block in loadAll() sets loadErr but no JSX consumes it, AND useMinDelay's first arg is still !session (not !session && !loadErr) — so even when loadErr fires, stillOpening stays true for 5s, then the `if (!session) return null;` short-circuits the whole component, leaving a blank page (or, if min-delay never resolves due to the timer dependency, the loading screen persists indefinitely). The patch described in the review request was either reverted or never committed. ROOT CAUSE for missing breakdown buttons: XPAwardPanel likely gates the [data-testid='xp-breakdown-btn-{cid}'] render on a non-empty breakdown row count or per-character action history; on a brand-new session with one character and no prior awards, the rows render zeros but the button is suppressed. Recommend always rendering the trigger (it can show an empty popover with 'No breakdown yet').
